title: Heap grooming / spray for CTF pwn
steps: Map every menu op to alloc/free/show/edit and record sizes; confirm `request2size` rounding in gdb.
Spray same-size chunks to fill tcache/bin state; use guard chunks so consolidation does not swallow the victim.
Groom LIFO order (free victim last) and verify the tcache head in `bins`/`vis_heap_chunks` before poisoning.
On glibc >= 2.32, encode the safe-linked fd with the true `next` field address; on >= 2.34 avoid dead hooks.
falsifier: No UAF/overflow or safe-linking plus a missing heap leak makes raw pointer poisoning crash.
